name: What should homeowners prepare before log and cabin refinishing begins?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners prepare before log and cabin refinishing begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the crew arrives, clear personal belongings, outdoor furniture, grills, and wall decorations away from work areas inside and outside. Ensure clear perimeter access around the cabin by trimming back overgrown brush, shrubs, and low branches that contact the walls. Take note of any known drafty spots, window leaks, or areas where water pools during rainstorms so you can point them out during the walkthrough. If interior drywall, painting, or tile upgrades are planned alongside wood finishing, remove fragile items from adjacent rooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear perimeter access around walls, trim back touching vegetation, move furniture, and list any known drafts or moisture leaks for the contractor to inspect.
